    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    holes = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            color = grid[r][c - 1]
            if color and grid[r][c] == 0 and grid[r][c + 1] == color:
                holes.append((r, c, color))
                out[r][c] = color
    for r, c, color in holes:
        for rr in range(r - 1, -1, -1):
            if out[rr][c] != 0:
                break
            out[rr][c] = color
    return out
